benchmarks_and_multiplicity.selection_rule: primary fixed before development and never replaced by a variant

economic_hypothesis: Large short-horizon BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT spot drawdowns standardized by only completed-session volatility may exhibit bounded next-session reversal sufficient for a diversified long-or-cash portfolio to earn positive net returns after conservative costs, without leverage or trend-rule reuse.

execution_contract.base_execution: desired exposure computed after session t executes at the first valid minute-bar open strictly after the maximum session event and availability timestamp
execution_contract.benchmark_accounting: same causal fill prices and self-financing costs; buy and hold drifts without rebalancing
execution_contract.missing_execution_bar: no fill and quarantine until state recovery
execution_contract.quarantine_accounting: returns touching incomplete sessions or missing fills are absent; signal state resets and resumes only after 150 complete sessions
execution_contract.return_interval: causal execution open to next causal rebalance execution open
execution_contract.typical_first_fill_after_midnight_sessio: 00:01:00Z open carried by the 00:02:00Z bar-end record

final_holdout_gates: same numerical and robustness gates as development with two positive of two folds plus independent terminal audit
holdout_open_rule: data contract remains PASS, every development gate passes, and an independent Sol/xhigh pre-holdout audit explicitly approves opening

primary_signal.entry_rule: when cash, enter long iff shock_t is less than or equal to -1.5
primary_signal.exit_rule: when long, exit to cash iff shock_t is greater than or equal to -0.25 or five causal execution intervals have completed since entry
primary_signal.state_rule: otherwise preserve prior long-or-cash state; insufficient, zero, or nonfinite volatility forces cash and resets state

raw_drawdown_baseline.entry_rule: when cash, enter long iff three-session simple return is less than or equal to -0.05
raw_drawdown_baseline.exit_rule: exit after the first strictly positive completed-session return or five completed execution intervals, whichever occurs first
raw_drawdown_baseline.other_accounting: identical weights, execution, costs, gaps, and cash treatment

regime_contract.assignment: at causal execution interval start from preceding completed BTC session only
regime_contract.definitions: same lagged BTC 120-session trend and 60-session volatility axes frozen for btc-eth-vol-targeted-trend-v1
regime_contract.development_gate: every eligible regime positive, at least three regimes eligible, and no eligible regime below minus five percent net return

statistical_contract.deflated_sharpe_ratio: same exact nonexcess-kurtosis seven-trial estimator frozen for btc-eth-vol-targeted-trend-v1
statistical_contract.probability_of_backtest_overfitting: same exact 8-block 70-split CSCV estimator frozen for btc-eth-vol-targeted-trend-v1

walk_forward_contract.fold_boundary: half-open and return interval endpoint strictly before fold end
walk_forward_contract.purge_and_embargo: not applicable to fixed lagged state rules; each fold is independently initialized from cash using pre-fold warmup without carrying positions or PnL
